introHtml: Faux leather lanyards badges offer a professional, upscale look without the cost of genuine leather. Ideal for corporate events, trade shows, or daily employee ID badges, these lanyards resist cracking and fading over time. Choose from multiple widths and attachment options like badge holders or key rings. Decorating with debossing or screen printing creates a subtle, elegant brand impression that stands out from standard nylon or polyester lanyards.
